projects.title: Oils
projects.summary: Oil paintings of figures turned away, and the pull between home and the road.
body: I trained as a screenwriter before I started painting, and I still think in scenes. For me, a painting is the moment just before or just after something happens.

I build each picture on the tension between warm and cold, between the calm of home and the urge to leave it. My figures usually turn away. I would rather you stand where they stand than look at their faces.
The work grows one painting at a time, like a diary of looking for a place of my own.

projects.title: Space Analogues
projects.summary: A feature film co-written with Jules Roux, in development.
body: A married couple signs up for a year-long Mars analogue mission. Cut off from the world, both the marriage and the crew begin to come apart.
The treatment is finished and the screenplay is in progress.

images.alt: A printed writing schedule for the screenplay, with scenes grouped by week

projects.title: Farma Česko
projects.summary: Scripts and the live finale for a reality show on TV Nova.
body: I wrote episode scripts and shaped the storylines for the Czech reality show on TV Nova, produced by Joy Department, working closely with the production team on narrative and dramaturgy.
I also developed production structures and wrote the script for the live finale.

projects.title: All that lies beneath
projects.summary: A short film co-written with director Jules Roux. Screened at FAMUFEST.
body: Marek goes down into a network of underground tunnels to find his brother, who has been led astray by the war. In dark times, when freedom is no more than a bird beating its wings, the brothers ask whether it can still be let out of its cage.
A 25-minute short film I co-wrote with director Jules Roux, from his idea. Screened at the FAMUFEST student film festival.

projects.title: Good night, sleep tight
projects.summary: A short film from my screenplay, directed by Jules Roux. Nominated for best film at FAMUFEST.
body: Anna has an important job interview tomorrow. If it goes well, her life could change. All she wants now is to get home, rest and get ready. But…
A 14-minute short film. Jules Roux and I co-wrote the script from my original screenplay, and he directed it. Nominated for best film at the FAMUFEST student film festival.

projects.title: Anna, seeking room
projects.summary: A short play I wrote and directed, staged at FAMUFEST 2022.
body: Anna, a girl from a small town, is looking for her place in a world that feels foreign to her. She has to come to terms with a new life and leave the old one behind, but making a new space for yourself takes a lot of strength. A touch of the Bildungsroman, and of suitcases on wheels. Is the housing crisis a state of mind?
Performed as a short play at FAMUFEST 2022, with the kind support of Kinokabaret, a student-run event that brings screenwriting students' scripts to the stage.
Written and directed by Roger Nicholas. With Patrik Možíš, Magdalena Škerenčáková, Kateřina Měchurová and Marek Nágl.

projects.title: I want to die as a martyr
projects.summary: Co-written with documentary filmmaker Juliana Moska. Produced by FAMU and broadcast on ČT art.
body: “I just saw a documentary about Syria. They have nice weather there,” says a future Czech jihadist over family dinner. It is a hopeless attempt to let his family in on what is driving him to join the Islamic State. Inspired by the case of Jan Silovský, the film follows the dark thoughts of a man set on leaving for Syria.
An 8-minute short film co-written with documentary filmmaker Juliana Moska, produced by FAMU and shot in the studio. It was broadcast on ČT art as part of a programme about young filmmakers.
